notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of 3 or greater.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fell Horseman, adding {C}{C}.
When Fell Horseman dies, it triggers, putting itself on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Fell Horseman into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
